status: Shared/personal saved filters implemented in both independently owned apps; scoped phone/tablet acceptance passed, broader native/paired acceptance remains open

semantics.shared: Readable projects with another accepted member, independent of task authorship
semantics.personal: Current user Inbox and owned projects without accepted collaborators
semantics.pending_and_declined: Do not make a project shared
semantics.subprojects: Use direct memberships, never inherited sharing
semantics.unknown: Missing catalogs or ambiguous/inaccessible/malformed references do not become personal through NOT/OR; query validation asks for sync
semantics.offline: Uses last synchronized membership snapshot, like other app data
semantics.capture: No invented shared destination or invitation writes

implementation.grammar: Strict valueless shared/personal predicates in existing v1 envelopes, roundtrip expression and visual builder controls
implementation.catalog: Grouped linear membership/project classification; query references carry optional sharing state, distinct from unknown
implementation.cache: Membership-derived flags enter TaskQuery identity even with unchanged task rows
implementation.surfaces: Same references in app list, preview, grouping, independent queries, child results and widget publication
implementation.widgets: Resolved task IDs only; no collaborator rows, member identity or invitation email published
implementation.storage: Only saved filter records added; no permission or database schema change
implementation.compatibility: Older strict readers reject new fields as unsupported; deferred rollout enforcement unchanged

core_checks: strict grammar/document values, roundtrip and explicit quoted search
genuine accepted membership, foreign owners and task authorship independence
unknown sharing stays excluded under NOT/OR with explicit validation error
nested and independent query scopes use the same sharing context
widget membership matches app and raw membership/email are omitted
saved-query queue/cache codec and conservative capture defaults
native_checks: Shared work created through expression editor
Personal work created through actual grouped condition picker
Shared shows exactly one accepted-project task
Personal shows Inbox plus pending-invitation project task
No shared task appears in Personal or vice versa
Normal relaunch without fixture reseeding preserves both views/results
Normal light phone/tablet captures visually inspected
verification.signatures: Both isolated current app products pass codesign --verify --deep --strict

database.method: Read-only information_schema, pg_policies, enum and FK inspection; no database or permission mutation

contract.accepted_members_visible_to_project_memb: (is_project_owner(auth.uid(), project_id) OR (user_id = auth.uid()) OR (has_project_access(auth.uid(), project_id) AND (status = 'accepted'::invitation_status)))

database_additional_checks.saved_view_envelope: Read-only live saved_views check constraint inspection and SELECT evaluation accept shared and personal version-1 documents
database_additional_checks.member_deletion: Live FKs cascade user deletion; accepted members are concrete linked identities
database_additional_checks.activity_limit: Existing TaskActivity state/ledger excludes assignment transitions, so its latest actor cannot identify the assigner
database_additional_checks.limits: Metadata/envelope checks only, not genuine paired account write/access acceptance. No database, permission, credential or account mutation

tablet_diagnostic.result: Same confirmed live XCTest run continued through six logged animation-complete waits and passed. The app was observed at 0% CPU in tool output; no restart or source replacement.
